notes: Variant WLC.EZK.27.6.v002 is underdetermined and resolved to r00-base; the gentilic כִּתִּיִּים is aligned as projected.

'inlaid in boxwood' for בַּת־אֲשֻׁרִים: split as construct noun ('inlaid') plus rectum ('in boxwood'). The competing reading treats the whole phrase as noncompositional, but the ASV spends separate English on each member, so rule 2 splits it.
